# Build only PathOps, which is a separate upstream GN source_set and is not
# included in the existing skia archive. Use its exact locked source list.
file(STRINGS "${XL_SKIA_SOURCE}/gn/pathops.gni" XL_PATHOPS_LINES REGEX "pathops/.*\\.cpp\"")
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${XL_SKIA_SOURCE}/gn/pathops.gni")
set(XL_PATHOPS_SOURCES)
foreach(XL_LINE IN LISTS XL_PATHOPS_LINES)
  string(REGEX MATCH "pathops/[^\"]+\\.cpp" XL_RELATIVE "${XL_LINE}")
  list(APPEND XL_PATHOPS_SOURCES "${XL_SKIA_SOURCE}/src/${XL_RELATIVE}")
endforeach()
if(NOT XL_PATHOPS_SOURCES)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Locked Skia PathOps source list is empty")
endif()
add_library(xl_skia_pathops STATIC ${XL_PATHOPS_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(xl_skia_pathops SYSTEM PRIVATE "${XL_SKIA_SOURCE}")
target_compile_definitions(xl_skia_pathops PRIVATE SKIA_IMPLEMENTATION)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(xl_skia_pathops PRIVATE /utf-8)
endif()
set_target_properties(xl_skia_pathops PROPERTIES CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN YES)
file(SHA256 "${XL_SKIA_SOURCE}/gn/pathops.gni" XL_PATHOPS_LIST_SHA256)
get_filename_component(XL_PATHOPS_INPUT_DIRECTORY "${XL_SDK_INPUT_MANIFEST}" DIRECTORY)
file(READ "${XL_PATHOPS_INPUT_DIRECTORY}/inputs.json" XL_PATHOPS_INPUTS)
string(JSON XL_PATHOPS_SOURCE_SHA256 GET "${XL_PATHOPS_INPUTS}" graphics skia source_sha256)
list(LENGTH XL_PATHOPS_SOURCES XL_PATHOPS_COUNT)
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/PATHOPS-BUILD-INFO.json"
  "{\n  \"module\": \"Skia PathOps\",\n  \"source_sha256\": \"${XL_PATHOPS_SOURCE_SHA256}\",\n  \"upstream_source_list_sha256\": \"${XL_PATHOPS_LIST_SHA256}\",\n  \"compiled_sources\": ${XL_PATHOPS_COUNT},\n  \"private_sdk_closure\": true\n}\n")
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/PATHOPS-BUILD-INFO.json" DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_DOCDIR})
